# Management groups

Deployment 1 of an environment: the management group hierarchy of the Azure landing zone, and which subscription sits where. Deploys at the tenant root group.

<!-- Generated by scripts/update-readme.sh from the compiled template. Edit the @description and @metadata decorators instead. -->

| | |
|---|---|
| Version | `1.0.0` |
| Use it | `using 'br/platform:solutions/01-core-000-management-groups:v1.0.0'` |
| Deploys at | management group scope |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|
| [pRoot](#proot) | yes | [rootType](#roottype) |
| [pPlacements](#pplacements) | no | [subscriptionPlacementType](#subscriptionplacementtype)[] |

### pRoot

The root of the hierarchy.

- Type: [rootType](#roottype)

### pPlacements

Subscriptions and the management group each one belongs in.

- Type: [subscriptionPlacementType](#subscriptionplacementtype)[]
- Default: `[]`

## Types

### managementGroupKeyType

Management groups of the hierarchy, named relative to its root.

- Type: string
- Allowed values: `decommissioned`, `landingzones-corp`, `landingzones-online`, `platform-connectivity`, `platform-identity`, `platform-management`, `platform-security`, `sandbox`

### rootType

The root of the hierarchy, right under the tenant root group.

| Property | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| id | yes | string | ID of the root management group. The groups below it are named <id>-platform, <id>-platform-identity, and so on. Example: `contoso` |
| displayName | yes | string | Display name of the root management group. Example: `Contoso` |

### subscriptionPlacementType

A subscription and the management group it belongs in.

| Property | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| group | yes | [managementGroupKeyType](#managementgroupkeytype) | Management group, relative to the root of the hierarchy. Example: `landingzones-corp` |
| subscriptionId | yes | string | Subscription to place there. |

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| oRootId | string | ID of the root management group. |
| oPlatformId | string | ID of the platform management group, where the platform stack deploys. |
